name: El Sewedy Electric Company
source: Consolidated El Sewedy Electric Company condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (KPMG limited review, translated from Arabic), statement of profit or loss, group column, EGP absolute: Revenues 163,315,717,414; cost of revenue 136,982,417,334; gross profit 26,333,300,080; selling and distribution 3,596,393,429 plus general and administrative 6,190,277,063 plus impairment of receivables 777,940,925 plus other expenses 527,794,969 less other income 1,180,306,043 equal operating expenses 9,912,100,343; operating profit 16,421,199,737; net finance costs 2,141,522,815; share of associates 572,617,216 and gains on sale of investments 542,976,117; profit before tax 15,395,270,255; income tax 4,748,555,104; profit after tax 10,646,715,151; owners of the parent 9,921,669,274; non-controlling interests 725,045,877; basic and diluted EPS 4.03. CRON 20261025: the H1 column previously carried the PARENT COMPANY (standalone) net profit of 3,076,015,933 and standalone EPS 1.34 beside consolidated annual years, a mixed basis; replaced with the consolidated owners figure so the column matches the FY basis.
source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (http://data.feedgfm.com/mix2/DCMServiceProvider?ROLE=A&RT=87&ID=3047906F-F76E-444F-940D-7E94E9212E51.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled.
note: Periods and blank series extended from stockanalysis.com (secondary provider, reported figures). A value was accepted only where the provider reproduced the stored figure for the same row in an overlapping year within 1.5 percent; no existing value was changed.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
